scope: Read-only independent static guide audit of every imported exact line and route variant; not official current network completeness.

definitions.line: Exact lines.id / lines.ref_raw; no aliases or punctuation changes.
definitions.variant: One retained routes.id; duplicates/loops/directions kept separate.
definitions.stop_platform: Distinct OSM element tables; no one-to-one physical place or pairing inference.
definitions.occurrence: One route_stops row or route_platforms row; repetitions retained.
definitions.missing_name: SQL NULL or empty/Unicode-whitespace-only string; baseline also separately records SQL ASCII-trim empties.
definitions.missing_point: Null/non-numeric/out-of-range/nonfinite point; nonpoint polygons/lines remain valid geometry, not fabricated centroids.
definitions.unpaired_endpoint: No exact reversed raw from/to within same line, excluding separately reported loop-evidence and incomplete endpoint labels; review only, not a claimed missing service.
definitions.road_connectivity: Shared exact coordinate vertex components, not verified routing or OSM node topology.
definitions.terminal: Mapped facility candidate; exact raw name or same-element evidence only.
definitions.hints: Platform route_ref lookup trim only; unmatched tokens not accepted as active lines.

limitations: No external source, operator verification, current operating census, or source repair performed.
Source member order cannot independently validate actual stop visit order or travel direction.
Road-way node IDs, one-way tags, turn restrictions and stop/platform pairing are not preserved in route_geometry; topology/routing remains unverified.
All supplementary catalogue/PDF evidence stays quarantined; observed platform route_ref tags are not proof of operating lines.
No arrivals, headways, provider-stop mappings, timing estimates or production changes.
